description: Administrators only, and this one CHANGES things: set the addresses a company's apps go through when its own address does not answer — a front proxy in another network, such as https://default-ru.kaiku.tech. Replaces the whole list; an empty list removes it. Each is an https origin with no path, three at most, tried in order. The name must also resolve to the company on its machine (WORKSPACE_ALIAS_HOSTS — bare for default, host=slug for any other company), which is deployment and not this tool. Answers the company's row with 'fallbackOrigins'.

origins.description: The addresses, in the order to try them, comma-separated; empty to remove.

slug.description: The company's slug, as admin_workspaces lists it.

name: admin_set_workspace_fallback
title: Admin set workspace fallback
